objective:
Follow these steps literally, one at a time, from the current page. Click only what each step names. Never type a URL, search, or take another route.
Where to find them, in the tutorial's own words: "To do this, click Create a book under Print/export on the left sidebar in Wikipedia."
1. Click the element whose visible label is exactly 'Create a book'.
If the page you end on has a main heading, store it as 'landed_on'; a page without a heading is fine.

actions.intent: PRIMARY: Main menu button; role=button; text="Main menu" | HINTS: position=top-left; container=Wikipedia header
actions.instr: Clicking the main menu button in the header
